description: Source file defining the tlvSupportedFreqBand class, which manages TLV (Type-Length-Value) structures related to supported frequency bands in IEEE 1905.1 protocol. It includes methods for initialization, finalization, and byte swapping, and handles parsing and serialization of the TLV data.

classes.name: tlvSupportedFreqBand
